title: Æbleskiver
hookLine: Norway-inspired æbleskiver with 10 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Æbleskiver
steps.instructionTemplate: Whisk the flour, salt, sugar, baking soda, and cardamom together in a large bowl. Separate the eggs and add the egg yolks to the flour mixture. Pour in the buttermilk (or cultured milk) and whisk the batter together until smooth. Cover and refrigerate for about 30 minutes. Incorporate {m53120_1}, {m53120_2}, {m53120_3}, and {m53120_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure flour first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build Flavor: Æbleskiver
steps.instructionTemplate: Use a hand (or stand) mixer to beat the egg whites until stiff. Carefully fold into the æbleskiver batter. Heat the pan on medium heat. Once hot, brush the pan with butter and fill each æbleskive hole almost full with the batter. Incorporate {m53120_5} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Shape & Layer: Æbleskiver
steps.instructionTemplate: Once the edges become firm use a knitting needle or wooden skewer to turn the æbleskiver about 1/4. Continue turning until you get round pancake spheres. They should be golden brown. Remove the æbleskiver from the pan and serve with powdered sugar and jam.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Measure aromatics and syrups before heating so timing stays crisp and your glaze hits glossy perfection.

steps.title: Cool 1 Minute on Rack & Plate
steps.instructionTemplate: Transfer Æbleskiver onto a wire rack for 60 seconds so steam escapes and the outside stays crisp. Top with {m53120_6}, {m53120_7}, {m53120_8}, {m53120_9}, and {m53120_10} and serve immediately into 4 portions.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 15 mins!
